sources.shortCitation: BN, Odeon O. 236842 — “Ninon, ach uśmiechnij się!” / “Signorina, signorina” (Kiepura)
sources.fullCitation: “Ninon, ach uśmiechnij się! : z f-mu «Zdobyć cię muszę». Signorina, signorina : z f-mu «Zdobyć cię muszę» / B. Kaper, W. Jurmann ; M. Halicz.” Jan Kiepura, vocal, with the Odeon symphony orchestra. Warsaw: Polskie Zakłady Fonograficzne “Odeon”, [post 1930]. One 78 rpm disc, 25 cm, publisher's number O. 236842. Biblioteka Narodowa, Magazyn Zbiorów Dźwiękowych i Audiowizualnych, shelfmark Fon.II.11.690; MMS ID 991034500969705066, OCLC 899876292. Language given as Polish, genre as film music. Marcella Halicz is credited “Sł.”, that is for the words. Accessed 2 August 2026.
sources.title: Ninon, ach uśmiechnij się! / Signorina, signorina — Odeon O. 236842
sources.creator: Jan Kiepura, vocal; Odeon orchestra

sources.shortCitation: Odeon O-11811, “Mein Gorilla hat 'ne Villa im Zoo”
sources.fullCitation: Hans Albers, with the Odeon-Künstler-Orchester under Otto Dobrindt. “Mein Gorilla hat 'ne Villa im Zoo.” Paso Doble; Odeon, Katalog-Nr. O-11811, n.d. The description gives the matrix number Be 10227. Discographic detail as given in the uploader's description; the label is not shown in the YouTube upload. The companion side, Odeon O-11811 a with matrix Be 10226, survives with its label filmed, which corroborates the catalogue number and places this recording as the reverse of the same disc.
sources.title: Mein Gorilla hat 'ne Villa im Zoo — Odeon O-11811
sources.creator: Hans Albers, with the Odeon-Künstler-Orchester under Otto Dobrindt

sources.shortCitation: Odeon O-11811 a, “Immer wenn ich glücklich bin”
sources.fullCitation: Hans Albers mit Odeon-Künstler-Orchester, Leitung: Kapellmeister O. Dobrindt. “Immer wenn ich glücklich bin.” Foxtrot a. d. Boston-Tonfilm „Heut’ kommt’s drauf an“; label credits “Musik: Walter Jurmann u. B. Kaper” and “Text: Fritz Rotter”. Odeon O-11811 a, matrix Be 10226, 78 R, B.I.E.M.; the label carries a dealer sticker of C. A. Klemm, Musik- und Pianohaus, Chemnitz, Brüderstr. 2–4, and the notice “Radiosendung ohne Genehmigung verboten”. Label filmed in the YouTube upload by Schellackplatte, uploaded 21 May 2008. Accessed 15 August 2026.
sources.title: Immer wenn ich glücklich bin — Odeon O-11811 a
sources.creator: Hans Albers; Odeon-Künstler-Orchester, Otto Dobrindt, conductor

sources.fullCitation: Hans Albers, with the Odeon-Künstler-Orchester conducted by O. Dobrindt. “Ich bin der Hans im Glück” / “In 24 Stunden.” Odeon O-11 810, shellac, 10-inch, 78 rpm, Germany, 1933. Side B, “In 24 Stunden,” is described as a tango from the Boston-Tonfilm „Heut’ kommt’s drauf an“, with music by B. Kaper and Walter Jurmann and words by Fritz Rotter; matrix Be 10225, recorded in Berlin on 9 February 1933, side A carrying matrix Be 10224 from the same session. Discogs, release 28872088. Accessed 15 August 2026.
sources.title: Ich bin der Hans im Glück / In 24 Stunden — Odeon O-11 810
sources.creator: Hans Albers; Odeon-Künstler-Orchester, O. Dobrindt, conductor

sources.shortCitation: Parlophone 80.235, “Was macht jede Nacht so ein kleines Baby in der Bar”
sources.fullCitation: Saxophon Orchester Dobbri, mit Gesang: Max Mensing. “Was macht jede Nacht so ein kleines Baby in der Bar.” Slow-Fox; label credit “Fritz Rotter & Dr. B. Kaper”. Parlophone, Katalog-Nr. 80.235, matrix B 38451, n.d. The label carries the B.I.E.M. mark; the uploader dates the recording to Berlin, 1930, and describes this pressing as a French Parlophon issue. Shellac disc from the Schallarchiv of the Radiomuseum Hardthausen, its label filmed in the YouTube upload.
sources.title: Was macht jede Nacht so ein kleines Baby in der Bar — Parlophone 80.235
sources.creator: Saxophon Orchester Dobbri, mit Gesang: Max Mensing
sources.date: n.d. [recorded in Berlin in 1930 according to the uploader]
